data.body: Execution update after claim: proceeding with the operator-clarified class-scoped design. Frontier and standard will retain their Bedrock primary and gain matching direct-Anthropic fallbacks; trivial stays single-arm because direct Haiku native-output parity has not been measured. The existing conservative whole-chain capability intersection remains unchanged. Operator-attested evidence already recorded in this ticket is sufficient for the exact direct Sonnet capability row: a live direct Anthropic NativeOutput call succeeded both without and with thinking, without reading or printing the credential. The plan-review advisory about credential provisioning is therefore stale relative to that recorded evidence and is not an additional implementation dependency. File impact and focused verification scope are now recorded.
